#  Online PAN application
If Name as per Aadhaar contains initials, please enter full expanded name (without initials) in the Name fields as applicable. Thereafter, you can provide your Name exactly as it appears on your Aadhaar card in the specified field "Name as per Aadhaar" while filling the form. Name as per Aadhaar will be printed on your PAN card. 
As per ITD guidelines,'Request for New PAN Card or/and Changes or Correction in PAN Data' application is presently to be used _**only for update/correction in PAN database.**_ For procedure to link Aadhaar with PAN, please click [here.](https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/help/how-to-link-aadhaar)
